lines.text: More appearance now works: accent strength, flat glass, corners, ring size and icons, haptics and motion.
Ring and gestures lets you choose the ring's apps and their order; Photos keeps the last place.
Home can space turns closer and hide the mic; the island can be a bar across the top, or off.
Briefing tiles you hide stay hidden on every phone, and The mind sets how many lines it puts on home.
